saraOnboarding.title: Get started with Sara
saraOnboarding.subtitle: Sara is your local Mynder Compliance Agent. She connects to your document sources and updates Mynder automatically — without documents leaving your infrastructure.
saraOnboarding.downloadHint: Click Download to get the installer file for your computer.
saraOnboarding.installHint: Run the installer. Sara requires no advanced setup — just follow the steps in the wizard.
saraOnboarding.configure: Start and run the configuration wizard
saraOnboarding.configureHint: Sign in with your Mynder account, approve access, and choose which document sources Sara should monitor.
saraOnboarding.connect: Connect to the right document library
saraOnboarding.connectHint: Connect Sara to where your compliance-related information lives: Notion, SharePoint, Google Drive, Confluence or local folders.
saraOnboarding.noUpload: You don't have to upload documents manually.
saraOnboarding.localProcessing: Document processing happens locally on your side.
saraOnboarding.onlyEvidence: Only evidence (coverage and metadata) is uploaded to Mynder.
saraOnboarding.newWay: This is a new way of working with compliance.
saraOnboarding.syncText: New or changed findings must be confirmed by a named person at your organisation before they count as evidence.
saraOnboarding.coming: Sara is not ready for download yet. Register your interest and we'll notify you as soon as it's available.
saraOnboarding.scheduleHint: Choose whether Sara runs manually or on a regular interval. Scheduled runs also look for signals that may affect previously approved findings.
saraOnboarding.never2: Never marks a requirement as met without human confirmation.
saraOnboarding.never3: Can be revoked at any time, with a trace in the history.
